description: This PHP source file defines the SaveReportingMethodController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. The controller manages the pre-render logic for a reporting method form, choosing between editing and saving modes based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveReportingMethodController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the pre-render logic of the reporting method save/edit view.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the appropriate Vue component ('reporting-method-edit' or 'reporting-method-save') based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.
